title: The Watcher's Guide
summary: Missing a melee attack with this spear grants advantage on the next attack against that target.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Simple, versatile, thrown and dippable, 5 ft.
fields.Death’s Promise: Miss a melee attack, including an Opportunity Attack, to gain True Strike against that target for 2 turns. The next attack against that target has advantage. Throw misses do not qualify.
fields.Rush Attack: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Charge 30 ft and strike the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Strength save vs weapon-action DC prevents Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and advantage to attackers. Damage or Help ends it.
fields.Acquisition: Sarcophagus among statues and traps in the Dank Crypt.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
